entries.title: Leviticus 7:1
segments: ¶'Likewise this [is] the law of the trespass offering (it [is] most holy):

entries.title: Leviticus 7:2
segments: 'In the place where they kill the burnt offering they shall kill the trespass offering. And its blood he shall sprinkle all around on the altar.

entries.title: Leviticus 7:3
segments: 'And he shall offer from it all its fat. The fat tail and the fat that covers the entrails,

entries.title: Leviticus 7:4
segments: 'the two kidneys and the fat that [is] on them by the flanks, and the fatty lobe [attached] to the liver above the kidneys, he shall remove;

entries.title: Leviticus 7:5
segments: 'and the priest shall burn them on the altar [as] an offering made by fire to the LORD. It [is] a trespass offering.

entries.title: Leviticus 7:6
segments: 'Every male among the priests may eat it. It shall be eaten in a holy place. It [is] most holy.

entries.title: Leviticus 7:7
segments: 'The trespass offering [is] like the sin offering; [there is] one law for them both: the priest who makes atonement with it shall have [it].

entries.title: Leviticus 7:8
segments: 'And the priest who offers anyone's burnt offering, that priest shall have for himself the skin of the burnt offering which he has offered.

entries.title: Leviticus 7:9
segments: 'Also every grain offering that is baked in the oven and all that is prepared in the covered pan, or in a pan, shall be the priest's who offers it.

entries.title: Leviticus 7:10
segments: 'Every grain offering, [whether] mixed with oil, or dry, shall belong to all the sons of Aaron, to one [as much] as the other.

entries.title: Leviticus 7:11
segments: ¶'This [is] the law of the sacrifice of peace offerings which he shall offer to the LORD:

entries.title: Leviticus 7:12
segments: 'If he offers it for a thanksgiving, then he shall offer, with the sacrifice of thanksgiving, unleavened cakes mixed with oil, unleavened wafers anointed with oil, or cakes of blended flour mixed with oil.

entries.title: Leviticus 7:13
segments: 'Besides the cakes, [as] his offering he shall offer leavened bread with the sacrifice of thanksgiving of his peace offering.

entries.title: Leviticus 7:14
segments: 'And from it he shall offer one cake from each offering [as] a heave offering to the LORD. It shall belong to the priest who sprinkles the blood of the peace offering.

entries.title: Leviticus 7:15
segments: 'The flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offering for thanksgiving shall be eaten the same day it is offered. He shall not leave any of it until morning.

entries.title: Leviticus 7:16
segments: 'But if the sacrifice of his offering [is] a vow or a voluntary offering, it shall be eaten the same day that he offers his sacrifice; but on the next day the remainder of it also may be eaten;

entries.title: Leviticus 7:17
segments: 'the remainder of the flesh of the sacrifice on the third day must be burned with fire.

entries.title: Leviticus 7:18
segments: 'And if [any] of the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offering is eaten at all on the third day, it shall not be accepted, nor shall it be imputed to him; it shall be an abomination [to] him who offers it, and the person who eats of it shall bear guilt.

entries.title: Leviticus 7:19
segments: 'The flesh that touches any unclean thing shall not be eaten. It shall be burned with fire. And as for the [clean] flesh, all who are clean may eat of it.

entries.title: Leviticus 7:20
segments: 'But the person who eats the flesh of the sacrifice of the peace offering that [belongs] to the LORD, while he is unclean, that person shall be cut off from his people.

entries.title: Leviticus 7:21
segments: 'Moreover the person who touches any unclean thing, [such as] human uncleanness, [an] unclean animal, or any abominable unclean thing, and who eats the flesh of the sacrifice of the peace offering that [belongs] to the LORD, that person shall be cut off from his people.'"

entries.title: Leviticus 7:22
segments: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

entries.title: Leviticus 7:23
segments: "Speak to the children of Israel, saying: 'You shall not eat any fat, of ox or sheep or goat.

entries.title: Leviticus 7:24
segments: 'And the fat of an animal that dies [naturally], and the fat of what is torn by wild beasts, may be used in any other way; but you shall by no means eat it.

entries.title: Leviticus 7:25
segments: 'For whoever eats the fat of the animal of which men offer an offering made by fire to the LORD, the person who eats [it] shall be cut off from his people.

entries.title: Leviticus 7:26
segments: 'Moreover you shall not eat any blood in any of your dwellings, [whether] of bird or beast.

entries.title: Leviticus 7:27
segments: 'Whoever eats any blood, that person shall be cut off from his people.'"

entries.title: Leviticus 7:28
segments: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

entries.title: Leviticus 7:29
segments: "Speak to the children of Israel, saying: 'He who offers the sacrifice of his peace offering to the LORD shall bring his offering to the LORD from the sacrifice of his peace offering.

entries.title: Leviticus 7:30
segments: 'His own hands shall bring the offerings made by fire to the LORD. The fat with the breast he shall bring, that the breast may be waved [as] a wave offering before the LORD.

entries.title: Leviticus 7:31
segments: 'And the priest shall burn the fat on the altar, but the breast shall be Aaron's and his sons'.

entries.title: Leviticus 7:32
segments: 'Also the right thigh you shall give to the priest [as] a heave offering from the sacrifices of your peace offerings.

entries.title: Leviticus 7:33
segments: 'He among the sons of Aaron, who offers the blood of the peace offering and the fat, shall have the right thigh for [his] part.

entries.title: Leviticus 7:34
segments: 'For the breast of the wave offering and the thigh of the heave offering I have taken from the children of Israel, from the sacrifices of their peace offerings, and I have given them to Aaron the priest and to his sons from the children of Israel by a statute forever.'"

entries.title: Leviticus 7:35
segments: ¶This [is] the consecrated portion for Aaron and his sons, from the offerings made by fire to the LORD, on the day when [Moses] presented them to minister to the LORD as priests.

entries.title: Leviticus 7:36
segments: The LORD commanded this to be given to them by the children of Israel, on the day that He anointed them, [by] a statute forever throughout their generations.

entries.title: Leviticus 7:37
segments: This [is] the law of the burnt offering, the grain offering, the sin offering, the trespass offering, the consecrations, and the sacrifice of the peace offering,

entries.title: Leviticus 7:38
segments: which the LORD commanded Moses on Mount Sinai, on the day when He commanded the children of Israel to offer their offerings to the LORD in the Wilderness of Sinai.
